authors: Chan, V., Rheinwalt, A. & Bookhagen, B.
citation: Chan, V., Rheinwalt, A., & Bookhagen, B. (2026). OrthoSAM: multi-scale extension of the Segment Anything Model for river pebble delineation from large orthophotos. Earth Surface Dynamics, 14, 391-416. https://doi.org/10.5194/esurf-14-391-2026
description: Segment Anything prompted on a point grid over overlapping tiles, with coarser passes for grains larger than a tile. Every clast is scored 1.0 (no per-instance confidence).
